comparison.objective: Use a messenger line to haul an out-of-reach dock line across a gap and place its eye over a bollard; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Tension-mediated deformable-line hauling and loop placement versus rigid small-tool alignment, controlled impact, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Dock-line eye rests over bollard and line is released versus four tangs physically fractured and deposited in a tray without damage or loss.
comparison.reason: The central ability is remote transfer through a coupled flexible line, not tool-mediated fracture. No spec versions or placement/tension thresholds are provided.
